texts.wy_age_id_note: Uma kuyiphutha, uzakwethu onelayisensi angahlola iminyaka yakho ngomazisi wakho. Uzakwethu ukhokhisa imali, eboniswa ngaphambi kokuthi uqale.
texts.wy_age_id_sent: Isicelo sakho sikuzakwethu onelayisensi. Landela izinyathelo zakhe ukuze ubonise umazisi wakho, futhi impendulo izovela lapha.
texts.wy_alert_note: Ukungena usebenzisa idivayisi entsha noma usendaweni entsha kuthumela isexwayiso kuzo zonke izidivayisi zakho, kanye no Bekungeyimi.
texts.wy_app_lock: Cela isigxivizo sami somunwe noma ubuso ukuze kuvulwe uhlelo lokusebenza
texts.wy_auth_note: Noma yiluphi uhlelo lokuqinisekisa olujwayelekile luyasebenza. Skena ikhodi noma uthayiphe ukhiye, bese uthayipha izinombolo ezingu 6 eziboniswayo.
texts.wy_basic_limits: Le akhawunti ivulwe ocingweni olulula. Engeza i-imeyili ukuze usebenzise ukukhokhelwa, amakhadi, ukushintshana kwemali nokuthengisa esitolo.
texts.wy_birth_invalid: Lolu suku alukho. Hlola usuku, inyanga nonyaka.
texts.wy_birth_note: Siyisebenzisela kuphela ukuhlola iminyaka yakho, bese siyakhohlwa. Asilokothi sigcine usuku lwakho lokuzalwa.
texts.wy_blocked: Imizamo iningi kakhulu. Izinsuku ezingu 7 le akhawunti yamukela okhiye bokungena nokhiye bokuphepha kuphela.
texts.wy_code_note: Ikhodi ihlala imizuzu emi 5 futhi isebenza kule divayisi kuphela.
texts.wy_codes_none_left: Akukho khodi yesipele esele. Yenza amasha.
texts.wy_contacts_note: Abantu abangu 3 kuya ku 5 obathembayo. Uma ulahlekelwa yizo zonke izidivayisi, ababili kubo baqinisekisa ukuthi nguwe.
texts.wy_country_lock_note: Vumela ukungena kuphela ukusuka emazweni owakhethayo. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze uvumele wonke amazwe.
texts.wy_country_note: Izwe lakho linquma ulimi, imali nezinsiza eziboniswa kuqala. Ungalishintsha kamuva.
texts.wy_email_note: Sithumela ikhodi kule imeyili. I-akhawunti yakho idinga i-imeyili nenombolo yocingo.
texts.wy_extra_note: Lokhu kungena kusha noma akujwayelekile, ngakho sicela ukuhlola okukodwa futhi.
texts.wy_keys_note: Ukhiye we-USB noma wokuthinta usebenza njengokhiye wokungena.
texts.wy_legal_no_digits: Igama elisemthethweni alinazo izinombolo. Lithayiphe njengoba linjalo kumazisi wakho.
texts.wy_legal_note: Ncamashi njengoba linjalo kumazisi wakho. Lihlala liyimfihlo futhi lisetshenziswa kuphela uma ukuhlola kudinga igama lakho langempela. Igama lakho elibonakalayo lingahluka.
texts.wy_legal_too_long: Igama elisemthethweni lide kakhulu. Lifinyeze libe yizinhlamvu ezingu 100 noma ngaphansi.
texts.wy_legal_too_short: Igama elisemthethweni lifushane kakhulu. Thayipha igama lakho eliphelele njengoba linjalo kumazisi wakho.
texts.wy_lock_first: Okokuqala, khiya konke: zonke izikhathi zokungena ziyaphela, amakhadi ayacelwa ukuthi amiswe futhi okhiye bayamiswa okwesikhashana.
texts.wy_locked: Kukhiyiwe. Manje buyela ngaphakathi ubheke okwenzeka kwezokuphepha.
texts.wy_lost_done: Uma imininingwane ibifana, i-akhawunti yakho manje ikhiyiwe.
texts.wy_lost_note: Khiya i-akhawunti yakho ngaphandle kokungena. Sebenzisa ikhodi yesipele noma ikhodi yakho yokubuyisa.
texts.wy_offline_signup: Xhuma ku-inthanethi ukuze uvule i-akhawunti yakho. Okuthayiphile kugciniwe.
texts.wy_org_note: Ku-Max naku-Enterprise: okhiye bokuphepha babanikazi nabaphathi, ubude bezikhathi zabasebenzi nezidivayisi zenhlangano kuphela.
texts.wy_passkey_note: Ukhiye wokungena ukungenisa ngesigxivizo somunwe, ubuso noma ukukhiya kwesikrini. Ayikho iphasiwedi okufanele uyikhumbule noma ebiwe.
texts.wy_phone_note: Sithumela ikhodi kule nombolo. Inombolo yodwa ayikaze ivule noma ibuyise i-akhawunti yakho.
texts.wy_po_consent: Ngiyavuma ukuthumela igama lami elisemthethweni nenombolo yami kunethiwekhi yami yeselula ngalokhu kuhlola.
texts.wy_po_free: Lokhu kuhlola kumahhala kuwe. Igama inethiwekhi enalo ngawe alikaze liboniswe noma ligcinwe.
texts.wy_po_id_doc: Inethiwekhi yakho yeselula ayikakunikezi lokhu kuhlola lapha, ngakho umlingani wethu onelayisensi wobunikazi uhlola umazisi wakho esikhundleni salokho.
texts.wy_po_match: Inombolo yakho iqinisekisiwe ukuthi ingeyakho. Lokhu kuhlala izinsuku ezingu {n}, noma kuze kushintshe inombolo noma ikhadi le-SIM.
texts.wy_po_network: Inethiwekhi yakho yeselula iqhathanisa igama lakho elisemthethweni nenombolo yakho.
texts.wy_po_no_match: Inethiwekhi yakho ithi le nombolo ayikho egameni lakho.
texts.wy_po_note: Kuphela ezintweni ezidinga umnikazi wangempela wenombolo yakho. Akusetshenziselwa ukungena kwansuku zonke.
texts.wy_po_partial: Igama lakho lifana kancane kuphela nelenethiwekhi yakho.
texts.wy_po_wait: Ikhadi lakho le-SIM lishintshwe muva nje. Ukuze kuvikelwe i-akhawunti yakho, lokhu kulinda kuze kube ngu {when}.
texts.wy_po_wait_how: Akukho okufanele ukwenze. Ngaleso sikhathi sizophinde sibuze inethiwekhi.
texts.wy_po_who: I-LynkOmni ayikaze ikhokhele lokhu kuhlola. Umlingani onelayisensi wesevisi ukwenza ekuhloleni kwakhe, noma okucelayo uyakhokha.
texts.wy_privacy_screen: Fihla amanani namagama uma isikrini sami sabelwana
texts.wy_problem_passkey_broken: Ukhiye wami wokungena noma ukhiye awusebenzi
texts.wy_qr_note: Vula i-LynkOmni ocingweni lwakho olungenile bese uskena le khodi. Isebenza kanye futhi iphelelwa yisikhathi emizuzwini emi 2.
texts.wy_recover_lead: I-LynkOmni ayinawo amaphasiwedi. Sitshele inkinga sizokubonisa izindlela zokubuya onazo.
texts.wy_recovery_note: Bhala ikhodi yokubuyisa ephepheni uyigcine ekhaya. Gcina amakhodi esipele angu 10 endaweni ephephile. Aboniswa kanye kuphela.
texts.wy_remember_note: Kukhompyutha esetshenziswa abaningi, ungakukhethi: uzokhishwa ngemva kwamahora angu 12.
texts.wy_restricted: Amahora angu 24: akukho ukukhokhelwa, ukushintsha ukukhokhelwa, ukulanda, ukushintsha amakhadi noma imininingwane yokuxhumana.
texts.wy_stopped: Kumisiwe. Isikhashana sizocela ukuhlola okwengeziwe njalo uma ungena.
texts.wy_strongest_note: Okhiye bokungena nokhiye bokuphepha kuphela. Awekho amakhodi nge-imeyili noma umlayezo. Izinguquko zilinda izinsuku ezingu 7.
texts.wy_too_many: Kuvulwe ama-akhawunti amaningi kakhulu lapha ehoreni elidlule. Zama futhi ngemva kwehora.
texts.wy_turn_off_note: Ukuvala ukuhlola kudinga ukuhlola okusha futhi kulinda kuze kuphele isikhathi sokuphepha.
texts.wy_waiting_note: Sazise yonke idivayisi nomuntu kwi-akhawunti yakho. Noma ubani kubo angakumisa lokhu ngokuthinta okukodwa.
texts.wy_way_contacts_note: Sicela abantu abasiza ekubuyiseni ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi nguwe. Ababili kumele baqinisekise.
texts.wy_way_id_note: Uzakwethu onelayisensi uhlola umazisi wakho nenombolo yakho yocingo. Abasebenzi ababili be-LynkOmni bayavuma.
texts.wy_way_other_device_note: Vula i-LynkOmni kudivayisi esangenile bese uvuma.
texts.wy_who_label: Igama lomsebenzisi, i-imeyili noma inombolo yocingo
texts.wy_word_note: Igama lakho eliyimfihlo likhona kuyo yonke i-imeyili nomlayezo wangempela we-LynkOmni. Umlayezo ongenalo awuvelanga kithi.
texts.wy_word_rule: Izinhlamvu, izinombolo noma izikhala ezi-3 kuya kwezingama-30, nganoma yiluphi ulimi. Izinhlamvu ezinkulu nezincane zigcinwa njengoba uzibhala.
